sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('17-FEB-1995'),'DD-MM-YYYY') a, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('17-FEB-1995','DD-MON-RR'),'DD-MM-YYYY') b, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('17-feb-95','dd-mon-yy'),'DD-MM-YYYY') c FROM dual
SELECT nume FROM studenti WHERE data_nastere BETWEEN '01-JAN-95' AND '31-DEC-95'
SELECT nume FROM studenti WHERE data_nastere = '17-FEB-1995'
SELECT MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_DATE('31-03-2015 18:00','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI'), TO_DATE('28-02-2015 06:00','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI')) x FROM dual
SELECT datcollate, datctype FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database()
SELECT DECODE(an, 1, 100, 2, 'abc', 0) x FROM studenti WHERE an = 3
SELECT NVL2(bursa, 'are', 0) x FROM studenti WHERE nume='Popescu'
SELECT an || bursa x FROM studenti WHERE nume='Antonie'
SELECT an || data_nastere x FROM studenti WHERE nume='Antonie'
